transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1774 Bethan Glen Lane?
Yes, this is 1774 Bethan Glen Lane. Everyone’s safe inside, no water in the house.
Thank you for confirming the address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Five people are here. No one can’t come to the phone.

Got it, five people here, no one can’t come to the phone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave on their own. No wheelchair or medical needs here.
Understood, no one is unable to leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
Thank you for confirming no water is inside the home. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No, I don’t have a truck, boat, or free seats to help neighbors.
Understood, no truck, boat, or free seats available. Let me read that back: 5 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes. Five people. No water inside.
Got it, thank you for confirming. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
